items.title: Critical Vulnerability in Popular Node.js Library Exposes Windows Systems to RCE Attacks
items.description: A serious security flaw has been discovered in systeminformation, a popular Node.js library used by thousands of developers. The vulnerability, labelled CVE-2025-68154, allows attackers to run malicious code on Windows computers. All versions up to 5.27.13 are affected, and developers must update to version 5.27.14 immediately. Systeminformation is a widely-used Node.js package that helps…
